name: accounts_open_close_fields
query: SELECT account, open.date AS opened, open.currencies AS currencies, close.date AS closed FROM #accounts WHERE account ~ 'Vanguard|Chase|Opening' ORDER BY account
notes: #accounts has one row per account with an open or close directive. Its columns are account, open and close; open and close are the directives themselves (structured values, NULL when missing), so SELECT * is not portable and this case reads their fields with attribute access: open.date, open.currencies (the constraint currencies, NULL when the open has none) and close.date (NULL: the ledger closes no account).
